items.headline: Backyard unit proposed at historic Washington Street home
items.summary: The November 5 Historical and Landmarks Commission agenda listed a public hearing on a recommendation for a 1,200-square-foot detached accessory dwelling unit and a 347-square-foot detached garage at 1391 Washington Street (PLN26-00020). The property is on the city's Historic Resource Inventory, so the alteration needs historic review, and the project was listed as categorically exempt from CEQA.

items.headline: Historic preservation ordinance update moves toward hiring a consultant
items.summary: The November 5 Historical and Landmarks Commission agenda listed the selection of one commissioner to serve on the review board that will choose a consultant for the Historic Preservation Ordinance Update. The ordinance sets the rules for how the city treats historic properties.

items.headline: Rosendin Electric office tenant improvement permitted at 3000 Orchard Parkway
items.summary: San José issued a permit for a Rosendin Electric tenant improvement, an interior build-out of an existing office building at 3000 Orchard Py. At a permit valuation of $10,255,535, it is the highest declared valuation in this batch.

items.headline: First Church gets permit for religious assembly build-out on Rue Ferrari
items.summary: A tenant improvement permit was issued for First Church Religious Assembly at 5891 Rue Ferrari, an interior build-out for church use. The permit valuation is $2,225,000.

items.headline: Council agenda: $11.8M to buy Finch Avenue property for parkland
items.summary: The November 2 City Council consent calendar listed a budget modification adding $11,825,000 to the Parkland Dedication Fund to purchase the Finch Property at 10480 Finch Avenue. Consent items are typically approved in a single motion unless a councilmember pulls one for separate discussion.

items.headline: Council agenda: $850K state grant for McClellan Road Bridge design
items.summary: The November 2 consent calendar listed a resolution to accept $850,000 in Caltrans-administered Community Project Funding. It also listed a design services agreement with Biggs Cardosa Associates, Inc. for up to $1,278,700 for the McClellan Road Bridge Project.

items.headline: Council agenda: study session on updating 2019 Emergency Operations Plan
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda included a study session on proposed updates to Cupertino's 2019 Emergency Operations Plan, the city's framework for responding to disasters and emergencies.

items.headline: City Hall advisory committee agenda covers building conditions and future options
items.summary: The City Hall Community Advisory Committee's October 29 agenda listed discussion and input on City Hall's existing conditions, facility needs, and future options. The agenda also included approval of the committee's September 21 minutes, and the public could attend in person or join by Zoom.
